digest.component_or_area: agentic execution runner and prompt caching
propositions: On the agentic execution path, the growing message tail is re-sent uncached every turn, causing input cost to grow O(N^2) in the number of turns
cache_settings_for sets only anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions, leaving anthropic_cache and anthropic_cache_messages unused despite their availability in pydantic-ai
The telemetry counter warn_if_cache_ineffective never fires because the system block hits cache, masking the O(N^2) uncached message tail cost from observability
Multi-turn agentic workloads require system-plus-message-tail caching per Anthropic and LangChain guidance, but rebar currently implements only system-level caching
The Bedrock and Anthropic model settings require different cache keys (bedrock_cache_messages vs anthropic_cache) because Bedrock rejects top-level cache_control
Single-turn execution paths must remain byte-identical to avoid regression
